canonical_title: Shortenit – URL Shortener & Link Management Platform
abstract: URL management remains a critical challenge for organizations and individuals who rely on sharing links across platforms. Long, unwieldy URLs are difficult to share, track, and manage, particularly in institutional settings where link performance analytics and access control are essential. Existing URL shortening services such as Bitly and TinyURL are cloud-hosted, raising concerns about data privacy, institutional branding, and limited customization. Shortenit is designed to address these challenges by providing a comprehensive, self-hosted URL shortener and link management platform tailored for Assumption University. It enables authenticated users to shorten URLs with custom aliases, track click analytics with geographic and device breakdowns, generate QR codes, and manage links through both a web dashboard and a command-line interface (CLI). With features such as Microsoft OAuth2 authentication restricted to AU email domains, role-based access control (user and admin roles), API key management for programmatic access, and full click analytics with geolocation, Shortenit reduces the dependency on third-party services while maintaining institutional privacy. The system runs as a self-hosted platform deployed via Docker, with a Nginx reverse proxy for production, ensuring that all data remains under institutional control. The project is tailored to the real link management needs of universities and organizations requiring privacy-preserving, customizable URL shortening workflows.

abstract: Smart Safe is an intelligent cash management system designed to improve the security and monitoring of physical money storage in small businesses such as convenience stores, gas stations, and retail shops. Traditional safes only provide physical protection but lack monitoring and automation features. Smart Safe integrates IoT technology, embedded systems, and web monitoring to provide real-time security and operational management. The system is built using Raspberry Pi, which connects to multiple hardware components such as:Camera module for monitoring, Solenoid electronic lock, Bill counter The Smart Safe system also includes a Kiosk web-based dashboard where administrators can monitor transactions, control locking mechanisms, and review camera footage from Line platform. The main objective of this project is to design a secure, intelligent, and automated safe system that reduces theft risk and improves financial tracking for businesses.

canonical_title: AU Connect: networking platform for AU
abstract: At Assumption University, many students would like to learn from alumni or seek advice from professors about careers and industry experience. However, there is no single platform where these groups can easily communicate and share opportunities. Most existing social networking platforms are built for a broad audience and are not designed specifically for a university environment. Because of this, connections between students, alumni, and professors often remain limited. This project presents AU Connect; a responsive web-based networking platform created for the Assumption University community. The system supports three types of users: students, alumni, and professors. It allows users to create profiles, share posts, connect with others, exchange messages, and discover job opportunities within the network. The platform is built using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and MongoDB, with Azure Blob Storage used for storing media files and Vercel used for deployment.

canonical_title: A Hybrid AI System for Personalized MG Car Recommendation
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: Choosing a suitable car can be challenging due to the large number of available models, specifications, and features in the automotive market. Customers often struggle to identify vehicles that match their personal preferences, budget, and lifestyle while underlying traditional automotive websites mainly rely on manual filtering and browsing. This project presents MGNITION, an AI-driven vehicle recommendation and showroom booking system designed to assist users in selecting suitable MG cars. The system applies a hybrid recommendation approach combining rule-based filtering, cosine similarity ranking, and regression-based score refinement to generate personalized vehicle recommendations. User preferences such as budget, seating capacity, fuel type, lifestyle, and driving needs are analyzed to produce the top recommended cars with explanation factors. The system also includes comparison of cars, showroom discovery, and consultation booking features. MGNITION is implemented using React, Flask, PostgreSQL, and Scikit-learn, demonstrating how AI can improve vehicle selection and enhance the car recommendation and booking experience.

canonical_title: MCG Care 2.0 (Air Conditioning Service Management System)
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: This report presents the design, development, and implementation of MCG Care, a digital platform created to streamline operations for an air conditioning sales and service company. The system addresses key challenges in service management, including inefficient booking processes, fragmented customer communication, limited-service history tracking, and manual scheduling. MCG Care integrates two platforms into a unified system: an iOS mobile application for customers and technicians, and a web-based admin dashboard for administrators. Its main features include automated technician assignment based on availability, skills, and location, QR code–based service history tracking, intelligent scheduling, and a community forum for customer support and knowledge sharing. Customers can register their air conditioning units, book maintenance services, participate in discussions, and provide feedback after service completion. Technicians use the mobile app to view assignments, scan QR codes to access service records, update job statuses, create service logs, and create time-off requests. Administrators manage products, services, technicians, bookings, timeslots, and forum activities through the dashboard. The system was developed using modern web technologies, employing NestJS for the backend API, Supabase with Drizzle ORM for database management, Next.js with React and TypeScript for the admin dashboard, and native iOS development for mobile applications. Automated scheduling algorithms and maintenance reminder systems ensure efficient operations and enhanced customer satisfaction. MCG Care's value lies in its ability to automate complex scheduling logic, provide transparent service tracking through QR codes, facilitate community-driven support, and enable comprehensive administrative control. The system bridges the gap between traditional service management approaches and modern digital solutions, providing a scalable foundation for service-based businesses in the HVAC industry.

abstract: This report presents the development of Clario OCR, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) extension designed to automate the processing of receipts and invoices using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology. The system aims to eliminate the need for manual data entry by automatically extracting financial and transactional information from uploaded documents and converting it into structured accounting data. By integrating intelligent document processing with business management software, Clario improves efficiency, accuracy, and productivity in financial record management. The system is developed as a module for Odoo 17, an open-source ERP platform widely used by businesses for accounting, inventory, and operational management. When a user uploads a receipt or invoice, the document is processed using Microsoft Azure Document Intelligence, which performs OCR to extract textual and structural data from the image or PDF file. The extracted information is then analyzed and organized by the Clario parsing system to identify important fields such as vendor name, invoice number, reference number, tax identification number, product descriptions, quantities, prices, and VAT information. The extracted data is automatically converted into a structured vendor bill within the Odoo accounting system, allowing businesses to review, edit, and confirm the information before saving it into the database. This automation significantly reduces the time required for bookkeeping tasks and minimizes human errors associated with manual data entry. Clario also ensures secure system integration and reliable data processing through its modular architecture within the Odoo framework. The system is designed to support multiple receipt formats and adapt to different invoice layouts using Azure's intelligent document analysis capabilities combined with rule-based data parsing techniques. Overall, Clario OCR demonstrates how the integration of OCR technology, intelligent document processing, and ERP systems can streamline financial workflows and modernize traditional document handling processes. The system provides a practical and scalable solution for businesses seeking to automate invoice processing and improve the efficiency of their accounting operations.

abstract:
In modern classrooms, maintaining student engagement and evaluating learning progress during lectures remain significant challenges. Traditional teaching approaches often rely on passive learning, making it difficult for lecturers to assess student understanding in real time. Although existing digital learning platforms such as Learning Management Systems (LMS) and collaboration tools support course management and assignment submission, they generally lack efficient mechanisms for real-time interactive assessments during lectures.

This project presents GamoRaX, a web-based real-time quiz and assignment platform designed to enhance classroom interaction between lecturers and students. The system enables lecturers to create quizzes using multiple question templates, including multiple choice, true/false, matching, and input-based questions. Lecturers can conduct live quiz sessions through QR code or PIN-based access and generate detailed performance reports for learning evaluation. Students can join quizzes instantly, answer questions in real time, and receive immediate feedback on their performance.

The platform supports both live classroom quizzes and take-home assignments with configurable deadlines and durations. Real-time features such as live leaderboards, automatic score calculation, and participation monitoring help lecturers evaluate student engagement during lectures. In addition, the system provides analytical reports including minimum, average, and maximum score statistics to assist lecturers in assessing student performance and adjusting teaching strategies.

GamoRaX is implemented using modern web technologies including Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and Supabase. Real-time communication is achieved through WebSocket-based interaction using Socket.IO, enabling instant synchronization between lecturers and students. The frontend is deployed on Vercel, while the real-time server is hosted on Railway, allowing scalable and efficient web deployment.

The results demonstrate that GamoRaX improves classroom interaction, simplifies quiz preparation for lecturers, and provides meaningful analytics for teaching decisions. The platform demonstrates the potential of real-time interactive assessment systems to support more engaging and effective learning environments in higher education.

abstract:
This project aims to develop EduTrack, a web-based application designed to assist students at Assumption University of Thailand (AU) in managing course auditing and academic planning more effectively. Students often face challenges in tracking academic progress, understanding prerequisite requirements, and planning future semesters, which can lead to missed courses, delayed graduation, and increased academic stress. At the same time, academic chairpersons face difficulties managing curricula, preparing tentative schedules, and handling graduation checklist submissions due to the lack of centralized tools. 
EduTrack provides a structured platform that enables students to monitor academic progress, review completed and remaining courses, and plan future semesters, while allowing chairpersons to manage curricula and academic rules more efficiently. As a continuation of the Senior Project 1, the system has been further refined and expanded with additional features to transform EduTrack into a complete and more comprehensive course auditing system. 
By integrating these improvements into a centralized platform, EduTrack aims to enhance transparency in academic planning and reduce administrative complexity in course auditing and graduation verification. The system supports students in making informed academic decisions while enabling chairpersons to manage academic processes more efficiently, ultimately improving the reliability and effectiveness of academic management at the university.

abstract: Transportation between islands is a fundamental part of daily life and tourism in the Maldives. Speedboats are one of the fastest and most widely used transportation methods for traveling between islands. However, the current process for arranging speedboat transfers is largely manual and unstructured. Travelers often rely on hotel reception desks, travel agents, or direct phone communication with operators to arrange transportation. This process lacks transparency, does not provide real-time schedule information, and makes it difficult to compare prices or check seat availability. This project proposes Shores, a web-based platform designed to centralize speedboat booking services in the Maldives. The system allows travelers to search routes between islands, view available schedules, compare prices, and make bookings online. Speedboat operators can publish schedules, manage seat availability, and confirm bookings through the platform. The system is developed using modern web technologies including React for the frontend, Node.js and Express for the backend, and MongoDB as the database. Leaflet is used to display interactive maps and visualize travel routes between islands. By digitizing the booking process, Shores aims to improve transportation accessibility, transparency, and operational efficiency for both travelers and speedboat operators.

abstract: TestHive is an AI-powered web-based learning platform designed to enhance interactive studying through automated quiz generation and gamified engagement. Gamified interface elements, real-time quiz sessions, and automated scoring mechanisms are incorporated to enhance user motivation and learning efficiency. By combining artificial intelligence, modern web development technologies, and gamification concepts, TestHive provides a scalable and efficient platform that transforms static study materials into interactive learning experiences.

canonical_title: Bangkok Buddy: An Intelligent Trip Planner for Foreign Tourists
abstract: Bangkok Buddy is a mobile app designed to help international tourists plan their trips to Bangkok more easily and personally. Tourists often struggle with scattered travel information, not enough time to plan, and a lack of details about entry fees, opening hours, and preparation requirements. Our app handles these problems by bringing together attraction data and automatically creating personalized travel itineraries based on user preferences and available travel days. The app uses Flutter for its frontend interface and Firebase for backend services and data management. It also works with Google Maps API and Google Places API for precise location data and map visuals. A rule-based itinerary generator sorts attractions based on user interests, groups nearby locations, and sets visit times based on daily travel limits. By merging organized attraction data with automated itinerary planning, the app cuts down on planning time, makes itineraries more practical, and improves the overall travel experience for tourists in Bangkok.
